slides.title: Horseshoe Lake Complex
slides.body: Walk the paved 1.7-mile path, or bring a ball for the fields and courts. There's a playground and picnic areas too.

slides.title: Hopatcong State Park
slides.body: It sits on Lake Hopatcong's southwestern shore. You can still see remnants of the Morris Canal in the park.

slides.title: Berkshire Valley WMA
slides.body: A former rail line runs north about 2.5 miles from the parking area. Trails aren't marked, so bring a map. Check hunting season dates first.

slides.title: Your Roxbury outdoor stops
slides.tip: Before you make an offer, spend a Saturday outside in the town.
